title: Infinite queries
objective: Paginate the real cursor API with useInfiniteQuery, a correct next-page parameter, and stale-cursor recovery.
predict: Load More appends exactly the next page. After a 409 stale-cursor response, restart the list rather than appending incompatible results.
expectedBehavior: Create 25 todo tasks; fetch pages 10+10+5 without duplicates. After adding a new task, the previous cursor should return 409 and the client should restart.
commonFailure: The starter guesses numeric offsets and never uses nextCursor or signal cancellation.
securityBoundary: Bound displayed pages and total task payloads. Infinite query caches can grow without limits; trim or evict older pages when appropriate.
